A '''ceremonial staff''' was owned by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Ultimate" /> around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]]<ref name="Hasbro" /> in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> It was capped by the [[Galactic Great Seal]],<ref name="Hasbro" /> a fanned [[Spear/Legends|spear]] that was used as the sigil of the Republic.<ref name="Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|I|310|Galactic Great Seal}}</ref> Valorum's [[Staff/Legends|staff]] had a [[Color/Legends|brown]] handle with dark blue joints at each end. The seal was set on a tan, circular base with two brown markings on the bottom, six smaller brown markings on the upper side, and two small blue dots below the center of the seal. The seal was brown and had three tips that extended past the circular base. At its center was a blue circle with a tan outline. Part of the top tip of the seal was tan colored, and the whole tip was surrounded by a thick, blue point.<ref name="Hasbro" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ceremonial staff was released as an accessory for Chancellor Valorum's action figure in [[Hasbro]]'s [[Star Wars: Episode I (toy line)|''Star Wars: Episode I'' toy line]],<ref name="Hasbro" /> released in [[May]] [[1999]].<ref name="Insiders">[[Star Wars: Episode I Insider's Guide|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''Insider's Guide'']]</ref> The capitalization of the staff's name was first confirmed by the [[2012]] reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Ultimate Action Figure Collection]]'' by [[Stephen J. Sansweet]].<ref name="Ultimate" />
